## AX.25 Packet Node GB7CAM

GB7CAM is a 2m AX.25 packet radio node serving the Cambridge area.  The station provides node, mailbox and chat services using LINBPQ and is connected to the wider packet radio network via RF and IP links.

```{=html}
<script>
async function fetchNodeSummary() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("api-status");

  const protocol = "https:";
  const subdomain = "api";
  const domain = "gb7cam.org.uk";

  try {
    let latestTimestamp = 0;

    // 1. Fetch Links Data
    const linksResponse = await fetch(`${protocol}//${subdomain}.${domain}/links`);
    if (!linksResponse.ok) throw new Error("Links API error");
    const linksData = await linksResponse.json();
    const activeLinksCount = linksData.links ? linksData.links.length : 0;

    // 2. Fetch MHeard Data
    const mheardResponse = await fetch(`${protocol}//${subdomain}.${domain}/mheard`);
    if (!mheardResponse.ok) throw new Error("MHeard API error");
    const mheardData = await mheardResponse.json();

    // 3. Filter stations by 4-hour window and separate by Port type
    let rfCount = 0;   // Port 1
    let axipCount = 0; // Port 3
    let otherCount = 0; 

    if (mheardData.mheard) {
      const fourHoursAgo = Date.now() - (4 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      
      mheardData.mheard.forEach(station => {
        // Fix unlabeled timezone strings by appending 'Z'
        let timeStringRaw = station.lastHeard;
        if (timeStringRaw && !timeStringRaw.endsWith('Z') && !timeStringRaw.includes('+')) {
          timeStringRaw += 'Z';
        }

        const lastHeardTime = Date.parse(timeStringRaw);
        
        if (!isNaN(lastHeardTime)) {
          if (lastHeardTime > latestTimestamp) {
            latestTimestamp = lastHeardTime;
          }
          
          // Check 4-hour validity window
          if (lastHeardTime >= fourHoursAgo) {
            const portNum = Number(station.port);
            if (portNum === 1) {
              rfCount++;
            } else if (portNum === 3) {
              axipCount++;
            } else {
              otherCount++;
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // Format the time text securely
    let activityText = "No recent activity";
    if (latestTimestamp > 0) {
      const latestDate = new Date(latestTimestamp);
      activityText = `Last activity at ${latestDate.toISOString().substring(11, 16)} UTC`;
    }

    // Compile separated ports summary text
    let stationsSummary = `${rfCount} RF, ${axipCount} AXIP`;
    if (otherCount > 0) {
      stationsSummary += `, ${otherCount} other`;
    }

    // Direct injection into your layout
    statusEl.innerHTML = `
      🟢 <strong>OPERATIONAL</strong> — 
      ${activeLinksCount} active links | 
      Stations heard (4h): ${stationsSummary} 
      (<small>${activityText}</small>)
    `;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Telemetry summary fetch failed:", error);
    statusEl.innerHTML = "🔴 <strong>NOT OPERATIONAL</strong> (Server unreachable)";
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchNodeSummary();
});
</script>
